summary.text: Mike Lance is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 79 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia, which lists him as Michael Lance, gives his profession as tool technician and firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Michael "Mike" Lance earned a bachelor's degree from Plymouth State University.
His career experience includes working as a tool technician, serving as a volunteer firefighter, and teaching for 35 years.
He assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 3, 2024, succeeding John Andrews.
